# Week 4: String Methods

## Problem Decomposition Context

Output must be clear and well-formatted. String methods process text. Identify output formatting needs. Example: Display results clearly → formatted strings, string processing.

## Key Concepts Overview

print() advanced usage. Formatted strings (f-strings). String methods: .upper(), .lower(), .strip(), .split(), .isdigit() (True when every character is a digit; False for "-5" or "3.5"), .isalpha() (all letters), .isalnum() (all letters or digits), .isupper() and .islower() (letter case). Problem decomposition: output format and text processing needs.

## Simple Example Demonstration

Clean and format survey response. Input (messy string), Process (.strip(), format), Output (clean string). response.strip().upper(); f'Student: {name}, Score: {score}%'.

## Connection to AI Tools

Pythonista2: What string methods are available? How to format output? Practice string manipulation for domain.
